title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: Orders containing glass are shipped in reinforced boxes. All reinforced boxes carry a handling label. Some labelled boxes are not reinforced. Order Iris contains glass. Order Moss carries a label, but its contents and box type are not stated.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
